Message:
Whenever I was afraid,
you’d take my hand and
tell me everything would be okay.

Whenever I needed help,
you’d always come
rushing to my side...

I depended too much
on your kindness,
and failed to see what
truly hid inside your heart.
I’m sorry for being so blind.

That’s why, from now on, I want
you to open your heart to me.
About your flaws,
and all the burdens you carry.

After all,
we’re the closest of friends.
All our suffering, our joy—
I want us to share
everything together.

I’ve always loved the sight of you
standing before me,
protecting me from harm.

But the truth is...
I don’t want to remain
helpless in your shadow—
I want to stand right beside you.

“A promise is something
kept by two people.
That is why I came for you.
So you and I can keep it...together.”

Please don’t carry your suffering
all by yourself anymore.
Share it with me too.

After all, Florence,
I believe you told me once before...

That you don’t protect me
because I’m weak.
You do so because
I’m important to you.

I feel the same.
I won’t stand beside you
because you protect me.

I’ll stand beside you because
there is no one more precious,
more dear to me than you.

So...please...
Allow me to protect you too.
